summary: Validated homepage responsive layout fix (ProductCard aspect-[4/3] with absolute inset-0 image). Measured carousel track and card image-box heights at 390px, 768px, 1920px for all four home-category carousels (masalas, artificial-jewelry, home-furnishing, christmas-decor). All image boxes are uniform within each viewport, no horizontal overflow, no console errors. Cumin-seeds portrait product renders fine as a card and on its detail page.

issues: Tracks masalas & christmas-decor are 385px vs artificial-jewelry/home-furnishing 341px (~44px delta). Image boxes themselves are uniform (261px) across all cards — delta is driven by text/badge wrapping under the card. Not the reported bug; purely a cosmetic row-height variance between sections. Can be unified by clamping title lines or using fixed meta height if desired.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Unify tablet-768 row heights across the 4 carousels (currently 341 vs 385) by clamping product title to 2 lines or using a fixed-height meta block. Not critical — original ~822px gap bug is fully fixed.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductCard fix is correct: image absolute inset-0 inside aspect-[4/3] overflow-hidden box guarantees uniform cells regardless of source aspect ratio.
object-contain used — portrait images are letterboxed, which was explicitly requested.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix verified across 390/768/1920. Only minor cosmetic polish remains (tablet row-height parity between carousels). All reported acceptance criteria met.
